Smith+Nephew is a portfolio medical technology company focused on the repair, regeneration and
replacement of soft and hard tissue. We exist to restore people's bodies and their self-belief by
using technology to take the limits off living.

# Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

Explore sports medicine

# Ultimate victory

Hear the story of how our technology, in the hands of a leading surgeon, helped Tom Aspinall recover

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## You Can Count On Us For Specialized Spine & Orthopedic Care

At our Spine & Orthopedic Center, we understand that your needs are unique and require a
personalized approach. We’re here to provide you with an expert diagnosis and solution, all within a
patient-centered care model that puts your comfort and recovery first. We are dedicated to providing
you with nothing but the highest quality treatments for a wide range of spine and orthopedic
conditions. Our team uses the latest techniques and state-of-the-art technologies to ensure better
results and reduced recovery time. At Acme Spine & Orthopedics, we focus on minimally invasive
procedures that, with minimum downtime, improve the quality of your life.

Where Do I Start?

[Dr. Barry Schapiro, MD]

## Meet Our Team

[Dr. Barry Schapiro, MD]

### Dr. Barry Schapiro, MD

**Orthopedic Surgeon**

Dr. Schapiro is Double Board-Certified in Orthopedic Surgery and Sports Medicine/Arthroscopy.

[Get More Info][58]
[Javier M. Figueroa, MD, PhD]

### Javier M. Figueroa, MD, PhD

**Neurosurgeon Specialist **

Dr. Figueroa, a skilled neurosurgeon, specializes in spine surgery, with expertise in adult and
pediatric care.

[Get More Info][59]
[Stephanie Belo]

### Stephanie Belo, PA-C

**Physician Assistant**

Stephanie Belo, PA-C, is a dedicated and highly skilled physician assistant specializing in
orthopedic care.

[Get More Info][60]

## Our Services

[Orthopedic Surgery]

### Orthopedic Surgery

Sick of typing “best spine orthopedic doctor near me” into your search engine? We don’t blame you!
Researching to find the best spine doctor can be tiresome. Here at ACME Spine and Orthopedics we
only offer our patients superior treatment. Dr. Barry E. Schapiro specializes in arthroscopic
surgery of the knee, shoulder, hip, ankle, and wrist. He also performs total joint replacement
surgeries. We pride ourselves on being the best spine and orthopedic specialists in Florida and are
ready to help YOU live your best life.

[Interventional Pain Management]

### Interventional Pain Management

Millions of people live with chronic pain due to a variety of reasons, and it often takes a team of
medical providers to help figure out short and long-term plans to relieve and handle this type of
pain. ACME Spine and Orthopedics has a highly experienced team of the best back surgeons, spine
surgeons, and interventional pain medication doctors around. We regularly administer spinal epidural
injections, PRP and stem cell injections, as well as conduct cervical, lumbar, and thoracic facet or
medial branch blocks, among other procedures.

[Minimally Invasive Spine Surgery]

cutting-edge technology can ensure you are free from pain, heal from your injuries, and enjoy an

# Manufacturing Leader

Adler Ortho^{®} has been a pioneer in the field of 3D printing for Orthopaedic products. Since 2007
we employ that technology to produce standard and custom made implants made either in Titanium or
CoCrMo alloy.

# SOLUTIONS AND SERVICES

Adler Ortho thanks to its mastery of the 3D printing technique applied to orthopaedics, offers a

## About US

Adler Ortho^{®} is a privately-owned company fully dedicated to the research, development,
production, and sale of medical devices for orthopaedics. Since its foundation, Adler Ortho^{®} has
been driven by innovation, pursuing the employment of the latest technologies available, with vital
direction and collaboration from the clinical community. We are a leading company in the design and
marketing of the highest quality orthopaedic implants, mostly produced with 3D printing technology.
[ Discover More ][65]

## Mission

Adler Ortho^{®} is committed to improving patients’ quality of life by developing innovative
products employing the latest technologies available, always in strict cooperation with the clinical
community.

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility
* [ Our Products & Services ][15]
  
  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

## Perspectives

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

[Perspectives][16]
* [ Patients' Stories ][17]
  
  Patients’ journeys inspire our work and drive our commitment.
* [ Healthcare Insights ][18]
  
  We’re engaging with industry thought leaders to explore how science and innovation advance
  healthcare.
* [ People of Baxter ][19]
  
  We are a community of diverse professionals working together to drive better healthcare options.
* [ Community Engagement ][20]
  
  Enriching the communities where we live and work.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.
* [ Our Governance ][23]
  
  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.
* [ Fueling Collaborative Innovation ][24]
  
  Nurturing a culture of innovation is critical to delivering on our mission to save and sustain
  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.
* [ Baxter Sustainability ][25]
  
  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.
* [ Inclusion & Diversity ][26]
  
  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.
* [ Our History ][27]
  
  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

## Patients

Helping you reach a healthy life, full of possibility.

[Patients][28]
* [ General Healthcare ][29]
  
  Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
  support every step of your journey.
* [ Nutritional Care ][30]
  
  When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide life-saving
  clinical nutrition options to help you regain your nutritional status.
* [ Respiratory Health ][31]
  
  We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven
  respiratory therapy in the hospital and at home.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

onboarding.

## Our ISO-Certified Cleanroom- Class 7

Our state-of-the-art ISO-Certified Cleanroom (Class 7) is designed to provide an ultra-clean and
controlled environment, ensuring the highest levels of precision, quality, and safety.**ISO 14644-1
(2015) standards**, our facility maintains a particle count of fewer than 10,000 particles per cubic
foot, creating an ideal setting for critical operations that demand exceptional cleanliness.

This technology uses **Advanced HEPA Filters**,**Temperature and Humidity Control** and **Versatile
Applications**.Our cleanroom undergoes regular audits to ensure compliance with global industry
standards, guaranteeing consistent quality and reliability.

[Want To Know more?][57]

## Benefits of Single-Use Surgical Instruments

[time]

Time-saving

[cost]

Cost-saving

[life]

Life-saving

As the name suggests, single-use surgical instruments are those instruments that are used once on a
single patient and then disposed of. Single-use instruments are intended for use only once per
person. The first use of single-use instruments must be their last use. After using it, one has to
dispose of it. Along with this, another question raised is what the reasons are we can’t reuse it
for the same patient? [Know more about its importance][58]

After passing stage 1 audit, we are pleased to announce that our **second MDR certification** audit

highest standards of medical device safety and compliance.

Our third-stage audit may be scheduled in six months. All certification processes are carried out
through the renowned certification body **SGS**, ensuring the integrity and quality of our systems

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.

  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

soldiers a decisive advantage. We design, engineer and sustain advanced tracked and wheeled systems
paired with modern electronic architecture, AI-enabled capabilities and autonomy-ready technology.

portfolio delivers proven performance and future-ready modernization for customers around the world.

Join the people who design, build and advance the systems that protect those who protect us. Our
teams see beyond the horizon, solving problems before they become challenges.

Bring your talent. Bring your purpose.

Let’s shape the future of General Dynamics Land Systems together.

 GDLS BRAND FILM

**We Serve Those Who Protect What Matters.**

A trusted partner of forces around the world, we deliver with agility, innovation and exceptional
customer support. Every day, our global team forges ahead into the next era of combat capability,
including autonomy-ready platforms, modern digital architecture and AI-enabled advantages.

That’s why Soldiers and Marines have trusted General Dynamics Land Systems products in the toughest
conditions for decades. We deliver the power to win.

[ Learn More ][36]

### ABOUT GDLS

General Dynamics Land Systems builds the combat vehicles and integrated technologies that give
soldiers a decisive advantage. We design, engineer and sustain advanced tracked and wheeled systems
paired with modern electronic architecture, AI-enabled capabilities and autonomy-ready technology.

From Abrams to LAV, Stryker to AJAX, robotic platforms to software solutions and beyond, our
portfolio delivers proven performance and future-ready modernization for customers around the world.

### Not a career.
### A calling.

Join the people who design, build and advance the systems that protect those who protect us. Our
teams see beyond the horizon, solving problems before they become challenges.

Bring your talent. Bring your purpose.

Let’s shape the future of General Dynamics Land Systems together.

## Common Questions from Practice Administrators

The questions that matter when you are deciding whether an IT partner can actually support the
practice without creating confusion.

What kind of medical practices are the best fit for HealthDesk IT

We are usually the best fit for small to mid-size New Jersey medical practices that need one
accountable team for day-to-day IT, phones, vendor coordination, security controls, and consistency
across one or more locations.

What do you handle, and what stays with our EHR or software vendors

We handle the infrastructure around your systems: network connectivity, workstation performance,
phones, internet, backups, endpoint protection, account access, and cross-vendor coordination when
issues overlap. Software-specific issues inside the EHR usually stay with the EHR vendor.

When should we call you instead of our EHR vendor

Call us when the problem may involve the environment around the software, like slow workstations,
network interruptions, access issues, printing failures, or vendor finger-pointing. We support the
IT infrastructure your EHR runs on, and we coordinate with the vendor when the issue crosses
systems.

How do you handle urgent problems during patient hours

We triage urgent issues remotely first so work starts immediately. If the issue is disrupting
patient flow and cannot be resolved remotely, we move to the fastest practical next step, including
on-site follow-through when hands-on work is actually needed.

How do you handle HIPAA, security, and BAAs

We handle the IT-side safeguards that support a compliant environment: access controls, device
standards, backups, endpoint protection, and practical operational security around daily workflows.
When our work involves ePHI, we execute a BAA where appropriate. Formal legal or audit
interpretation stays with dedicated compliance specialists.

## Common Questions from Practice Administrators

The questions that matter when you are deciding whether an IT partner can actually support the
practice without creating confusion.

What kind of medical practices are the best fit for HealthDesk IT

accountable team for day-to-day IT, phones, vendor coordination, security controls, and consistency
across one or more locations.

What do you handle, and what stays with our EHR or software vendors

We handle the infrastructure around your systems: network connectivity, workstation performance,
phones, internet, backups, endpoint protection, account access, and cross-vendor coordination when
issues overlap. Software-specific issues inside the EHR usually stay with the EHR vendor.

When should we call you instead of our EHR vendor

Call us when the problem may involve the environment around the software, like slow workstations,
network interruptions, access issues, printing failures, or vendor finger-pointing. We support the
IT infrastructure your EHR runs on, and we coordinate with the vendor when the issue crosses
systems.

on-site follow-through when hands-on work is actually needed.

standards, backups, endpoint protection, and practical operational security around daily workflows.

interpretation stays with dedicated compliance specialists.

Experience the #1 insulin pump in preventing highs and lows based on user satisfaction,¹ and our

Our Insulin management solutions

INSULIN PUMP THERAPY

### Self-adjusting insulin pump

The MiniMed^{TM} 780G system automatically corrects glucose levels every 5 minutes based on
real-time CGM readings to optimise Time in Range*. This means freedom to eat what and when you want,
more restful nights with fewer beeps. That`s less time needing to think about diabetes.

The pump system also offers a small, 15-day sensor and 7-day infusion set, for longer wear.
 

* Refers to SmartGuard^{TM} technology, individual results may vary.

Fewer injections compared to MDI

[80%]

Helps to reach 80% Time in range²

[Close Modal]

MULTIPLE DAILY INJECTION THERAPIES

### MiniMed Go system

MiniMed Go^{TM} is the only smart MDI system that continuously monitors glucose, proactively
notifies you when you need more insulin and recommends a correction dose.^{3,4,¶}

It combines the power of the latest innovation in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM), Instinct Go,
made by Abbott, with the InPen^{TM} Smart Insulin Pen and the MiniMed Go^{TM} app.

more restful nights with fewer beeps. That`s less time needing to think about diabetes.

### Your Revenue Cycle, Running on Autopilot.

OSP's Agentic AI Revenue Engine automates the most repetitive task in your billing workflow —
calling payers to check claim status. It makes the calls, captures the updates, and reports
everything in real time, so your team spends zero time on hold.

#### What It Does:
* Automatically calls payers to check claim status
* Captures claim updates without any manual follow-up
* Logs and reports claim status directly to an Excel sheet
* Replaces hours of staff time spent on hold with payers

[ See It In Action ][113]
[RCM Revenue Engine Dashboard]
4x Faster Denial Resolution with AI
5x Reduction in Denial Management Workload

### Stop Writing Off Denied Claims. Start Recovering Them.

OSP's RCM Revenue Engine pulls denied claims from any source — EHR, clearinghouse, or manual upload
— uses AI to identify the root cause, determines the best course of action, and automates the entire
resolution workflow. From appeal letters to resubmissions to payer follow-up, it handles the work
your team never has time for.

#### What It Does
* Identifies root cause of every denial using AI
* Auto-generates appeal letters tailored to payer requirements
* Resubmits claims or routes complex cases to staff
* Tracks every denial from identification to resolution

[ See It In Action ][114]
[Claims Scrubbing Dashboard]
95%+ First-Pass Clean Claim Rate
50% Reduction in Manual Claim Review

### Every Claim Scrubbed Before It Leaves Your Office.

OSP's AI Claims Scrubbing Agent validates every claim before submission — checking coding accuracy,
payer rules, NCCI edits, and eligibility in real time. It catches the errors, suggests the fixes,
and routes clean claims to the payer, so your billing team never wastes time on preventable denials.

#### What It Does
* Automatically validates CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS codes against payer-specific rules
* Catches coding errors, missing modifiers, and bundling violations before submission
* Verifies patient eligibility, prior auth, and COB in real time
* Routes clean claims to payer and flags dirty claims with specific fix instructions

### Your Revenue Cycle, Running on Autopilot.

OSP's Agentic AI Revenue Engine automates the most repetitive task in your billing workflow —
calling payers to check claim status. It makes the calls, captures the updates, and reports
everything in real time, so your team spends zero time on hold.

#### What It Does:
* Automatically calls payers to check claim status
* Captures claim updates without any manual follow-up
* Logs and reports claim status directly to an Excel sheet
* Replaces hours of staff time spent on hold with payers

[ See It In Action ][113]
[RCM Revenue Engine Dashboard]
4x Faster Denial Resolution with AI
5x Reduction in Denial Management Workload

### Stop Writing Off Denied Claims. Start Recovering Them.

OSP's RCM Revenue Engine pulls denied claims from any source — EHR, clearinghouse, or manual upload
— uses AI to identify the root cause, determines the best course of action, and automates the entire
resolution workflow. From appeal letters to resubmissions to payer follow-up, it handles the work
your team never has time for.

#### What It Does
* Identifies root cause of every denial using AI
* Auto-generates appeal letters tailored to payer requirements
* Resubmits claims or routes complex cases to staff
* Tracks every denial from identification to resolution

[ See It In Action ][114]
[Claims Scrubbing Dashboard]
95%+ First-Pass Clean Claim Rate
50% Reduction in Manual Claim Review

### Every Claim Scrubbed Before It Leaves Your Office.

OSP's AI Claims Scrubbing Agent validates every claim before submission — checking coding accuracy,
payer rules, NCCI edits, and eligibility in real time. It catches the errors, suggests the fixes,
and routes clean claims to the payer, so your billing team never wastes time on preventable denials.

#### What It Does
* Automatically validates CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS codes against payer-specific rules
* Catches coding errors, missing modifiers, and bundling violations before submission
* Verifies patient eligibility, prior auth, and COB in real time
* Routes clean claims to payer and flags dirty claims with specific fix instructions

About OurHealthNetwork

### How do I find a doctor near me?

Use the search above to find doctors by specialty, condition, or name in your city. OurHealthNetwork
includes 5.5 million providers across 124 specialties, all sourced from official CMS databases.
Filter by insurance acceptance, Medicare status, and telehealth availability.

### Is OurHealthNetwork free to use?

Yes. Searching for healthcare providers, comparing quality ratings, viewing insurance acceptance
data, and reading patient reviews is completely free. No account required.

### Where does your data come from?

Provider data comes from the CMS National Provider Identifier (NPI) Registry and the CMS Doctors and
Clinicians database. Facility data comes from CMS Hospital Compare, Nursing Home Compare, and other
CMS quality programs. Insurance data comes from transparency-in-coverage files published by 61 major
insurers.

### Can I find doctors that accept my insurance?

Yes. We maintain insurance acceptance data covering 3.6 million providers from 84 insurers. Search
by your specialty, then filter by insurance on the results page. Each doctor profile also lists
their accepted plans.

### How are healthcare facilities rated?

CMS assigns 1 to 5 star quality ratings to hospitals, nursing homes, dialysis centers, and home
health agencies based on clinical outcomes, patient safety, staffing, and patient experience. Our
facility pages display these ratings alongside detailed quality data.

### Are you affiliated with any healthcare providers?

No. OurHealthNetwork is an independent healthcare platform. We are not affiliated with any provider,
hospital system, or insurance company. Our rankings and data are never influenced by advertising or
paid placements.

## Frequently Asked Questions

About OurHealthNetwork

### How do I find a doctor near me?

Use the search above to find doctors by specialty, condition, or name in your city. OurHealthNetwork
includes 5.5 million providers across 124 specialties, all sourced from official CMS databases.
Filter by insurance acceptance, Medicare status, and telehealth availability.

### Is OurHealthNetwork free to use?

Yes. Searching for healthcare providers, comparing quality ratings, viewing insurance acceptance
data, and reading patient reviews is completely free. No account required.

### Where does your data come from?

Provider data comes from the CMS National Provider Identifier (NPI) Registry and the CMS Doctors and
Clinicians database. Facility data comes from CMS Hospital Compare, Nursing Home Compare, and other
CMS quality programs. Insurance data comes from transparency-in-coverage files published by 61 major
insurers.

### Can I find doctors that accept my insurance?

Yes. We maintain insurance acceptance data covering 3.6 million providers from 84 insurers. Search
by your specialty, then filter by insurance on the results page. Each doctor profile also lists
their accepted plans.

### How are healthcare facilities rated?

CMS assigns 1 to 5 star quality ratings to hospitals, nursing homes, dialysis centers, and home
health agencies based on clinical outcomes, patient safety, staffing, and patient experience. Our
facility pages display these ratings alongside detailed quality data.

### Are you affiliated with any healthcare providers?

No. OurHealthNetwork is an independent healthcare platform. We are not affiliated with any provider,
hospital system, or insurance company. Our rankings and data are never influenced by advertising or
paid placements.

Data source: CMS NPPES, CMS DAC, CMS Provider Compare, Transparency in Coverage filings · Last
updated: monthly

# Expert Medical & Dental VAs

Vital Virtuals provides professionally trained, pre-vetted Virtual Assistants to help medical and
dental practices run smoother—so you can focus on delivering exceptional patient care.

Discover the Benefits

## Regain Control of Your Time

###### Reduce Admin Time, Boost Bottom Line

#### Streamlined Admin

Our Medical VAs handle billing, scribing, and reception, freeing your time for patients and personal
life.

#### Work-Life Balance

Our Medical VAs handle routine tasks, letting you leave on time, reduce burnout, and enjoy family
time.

#### Enhanced Productivity

Our Medical VAs streamline workflows, helping your team be efficient, boost patient care, and focus
on what matters.

## Services Provided

We provide comprehensive healthcare virtual assistant services designed to support medical and
dental practices. Our experienced Medical Virtual Assistants handle front-office, clinical, and
administrative tasks—including patient scheduling, communication, medical and dental reception,
scribing, billing, and insurance coordination—so providers can focus on delivering quality care
while maintaining an efficient and organized practice.



#### Medical / Dental Receptionist

Handles patient calls, scheduling, and front-desk communication.



#### Medical / Dental Scribe

Documents patient visits in real time for providers. Records dental treatment notes accurately
during procedures.



#### Medical / Dental Biller

Submits claims and
manages patient / insurance billing.



#### Prior Authorization

Secures insurance approvals for medications and procedures.

markets such as Southeast Asia and Europe, WEGO has wrestled with many European and American brands,

African countries.**

future medical needs.**

improve some infrastructure, and guide these African doctors to visit and study in China and train,
